universal_lens: Reference point theory in behavioral economics maps to situational violence triggers via loss aversion and team rivalry dynamics. Contextualized ordinal regression models with exogenous variables map to Bayesian belief updates over match salience and domestic violence triggers.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference models domestic violence spikes using Old Firm match outcomes as latent variables with prior distributions over reference points. GSI employs conformal predictive distributions over match indicators to infer conditional probabilities of domestic violence events, adjusting for temporal and spatial covariates.
gse_mapping: Situationally grounded state transitions model spectator behavior shifts from expectation to emotional arousal during high-stakes football encounters. GSE encodes state transitions between match contexts (home/away, TV, importance) into dynamic belief networks that update emotional salience thresholds for violence prediction.
